answer_2.quote: Accuracy (exact-match) and average F1 are both common QA metrics . Since both are related and some statistical tests require binary scores, we focus on exact-match.

answer_4.quote: Three authors manually verify entity assignments by vetting fifty random questions from each dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Questions with at least one entity had near-perfect 96% inter-annotator agreement for CLOUD-NL's annotations, while for questions where CLOUD-NL didn't find any entity, agreement is 98%.
